headline: Rogers State alone remain unbeaten
dek: Ouachita Baptist conceded three times in defeat by Dallas Baptist, the first goals they had let in this season, and Rogers State's draw at UT Tyler was the first match they have not won. Nine different players have now scored for Rogers State; no other programme has more than six.
displaced_by: Ouachita Baptist's first defeat and Rogers State's first draw leave Rogers State the only unbeaten side

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State have outscored Newman, Northeastern State and Harding put together.

wire.line: Ouachita Baptist's unbeaten start ended at home to Dallas Baptist, the first goals they had conceded all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: There is no score gap: every match marked final carries a score, and no match is past its date without a result.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Every match with a published score also has a box score behind it. The collector reached the detail of each.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Against outside opponents the conference has scored thirty-seven goals and conceded thirty-two, yet has twelve defeats to eleven wins. Rogers State's draw at UT Tyler is the second match this season that a programme in this conference has neither won nor lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Northeastern State's win over Oklahoma Christian was their first of the season, and their four goals have come from three different players.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Harding have lost all three of their matches, every one of them at home, scoring once and conceding five. Reik Barrack is their only scorer.

last_match.line: Ouachita Baptist had not conceded a goal before this match; they leave it with their first defeat, and Rogers State as the conference's only unbeaten side.

next_match.line: Fort Hays State have yet to play away; every match so far has been at home, including their only defeat.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
